name: Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis
definition: Chronic inflammatory arthritis beginning before age 16, encompassing several subtypes with variable joint, systemic and ocular manifestations.

redFlags.item: Systemic JIA with severe systemic inflammation

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical after exclusion of mimics; labs support classification and safety monitoring.
investigations.MRI: Ultrasound/MRI may show synovitis and joint damage.

red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Balya Sandhi-shotha phenotype may be documented only in parallel with formal JIA classification.

patientEducation.summary: Chronic inflammatory arthritis beginning before age 16, encompassing several subtypes with variable joint, systemic and ocular manifestations.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
